Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC scoped and scheduled:

- Validate inference latency <= 120ms p95 for interactive triage flows under expected concurrency.
- Cost estimate for production footprint at steady-state RPS with burst handling.
- Quality: model outputs match current baseline on 3 key prompt sets (triage, billing extraction, summary).

Proposed evaluation plan & timelines:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize workload intake & security checklist so we can provision a dedicated POC environment.
- Week 1: seed samples, run baseline against your current model, validate latency and throughput.
- Week 2: run extended traffic tests (burst patterns), tweak batching/quantization configs, hand off evaluation report.

- Ben Carter (sales) - POC owner / commercial coordination.

- Dylan Brooks (engineer) - runtime configuration and load testing.

Hi Alicia / Ben 

Thanks for the sample data - quick technical notes ahead of the kickoff: 

Preliminary sizing and config suggestions (based on: steady 15 RPS, 120 RPS bursts, avg 350 tokens / 95th 900 tokens):
- Suggest a small dedicated POC pool with 2x A100-equivalent GPUs (or equivalent T4 slices depending on cost) to hit latency/p95 targets while allowing for bursts.
- Enable dynamic batching with a 30ms batch window; configure batch size cap so 95th token-length requests don't push p95 over the 120ms target.
- KV/prefix caching: we can cache shared system prompts to reduce token overhead.
- For long extraction requests (900 tokens) we recommend a quantized model variant for throughput testing; we'll run comparisons during week 1.

Load test plan for Week 1 (summary):
1) Baseline run: 15 RPS steady for 30m, measure p50/p95/p99 and token throughput.
2) Burst test: ramp to 120 RPS for 2m windows with short cooldowns, measure tail latency and error rate.
3) Concurrency test: simulate 10 concurrent in-flight requests and ensure per-connection latency stays within SLO.

Access & artifacts we need before kickoff:
- Short-lived API key or sample authentication method (so we can run early smoke tests).
- Network whitelist IPs (we'll provide a list).
- A representative sample dataset (already have sample-queries.csv - thanks).

I'll prepare a short load-test harness and share the first results within 48 hours after environment provision.

Dylan Brooks
